As Ares Cap (ARCC) Stock Value Rose, Clough Capital Partners LP Lowered Its Holding; Northstar Investment Advisors Continues to Hold Stake in Texas Instruments (TXN)
June 27, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Charles Clough decreased its stake in Ares Cap Corp (ARCC) by 6.36% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Clough Capital Partners LP sold 159,400 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.82% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Charles Clough held 2.35M shares of the company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $37.25 million, down from 2.51 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clough Capital Partners LP who had been investing in Ares Cap Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $7.08B market cap company. The stock increased 0.03% or $0.005 during the last trading session, reaching $16.615. About 886,196 shares traded. Ares Capital Corporation (NASDAQ:ARCC) has declined 0.18% since June 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 12.75% the S&P500.
